summary: WHISPERS : Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype whose MMORPG Tools menu and character-creation flow lead into the Lantern March. Its main place combines the Lantern's Reach hub, Windmill Farm, newly authored tool props and a townhouse with procedural continent terrain; the MMORPG Tools mod owns RPG lifecycle, player state, cameras and UI.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - default title/travel menu scene with authored town art and shared terrain decoration.
places/character-creation-land/ - character preview scene with terrain off and a preview camera/lighting setup.
places/main/ - Lantern March continent: Reach hub at origin, farm SW, Briarwild west, quarry east, and distant regions; 29 cells cover the expanded area.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Reach hub and Windmill Farm props, smithy tool props, and the two-storey townhouse north of the inn; x1z0 adds quarry tool props among east-side copper nodes.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry/defaultPlace main-menu-land; binds shared player, camera, arrival, MMORPG UI and nametag behavior.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - MMORPG Tools template/behavior registration for menu, player and gameplay/creation camera behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - native player template; runs humanoid locomotion then core movement behavior.
templates/camera.js#camera - native custom camera template; core scripts/camera.js consumes engine look orientation.
places/main-menu-land/config.yaml and places/character-creation-land/config.yaml - separate menu/preview place roots and atmosphere settings.
places/main/config.yaml - playable-world spawn, gravity, terrain generator/materials, vegetation scatter and cinematic look.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ - integrated RPG package: lifecycle, character selection, gameplay/creation cameras, interaction, quests and UI.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - shared RPG data registries and panel renderers used by mod behaviors and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/item-icons.js - item-id icon registry reused by inventory rendering; iconFor falls back to an item's existing icon.
scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js and windmill*.js - procedural geometry used by authored scene instances with parameters.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, pebble.js and grass-look.js - terrain decoration geometry/material reused by place scatter bindings.
scripts/lib/regions.js - named Lantern March region definitions and regionAt lookup; ui-hud.js currently mirrors its tests inline rather than importing it.
scripts/lib/data/{player,camera,world}.yml - shared movement, camera-height and terrain-height values read by core scripts.
art/tools/build.py and art/townhouse/build.py - Blender asset builders for tool-pack GLBs and the scene's textured townhouse GLB, respectively.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onInput, update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit, onInput, update.
scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, update; scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/terrain-reach.js - QUARRY, FOREST, CRYPT, FEN, BAY, heightAt, materialAt; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
scripts/gen/stone-bridge.js, farm.js, windmill.js and windmill-sails.js - geometry, collider; scripts/gen/shape.js supplies box/quad helpers.
scripts/sails-spin.js - onSpawn; animates the windmill sail assembly.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - movement/state, avatar and roster/music helpers, saveCharacter, onSpawn and lifecycle handlers.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/character-select.js - preview/model helpers, onSpawn, update, onInput; main-menu-mgr.js owns roster/menu handlers.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/shop-data.js - hasShop, getShopItems, findShopItem; lib/item-icons.js - ITEM_ICONS, iconFor; lib/ui-inventory.js - buildItemTooltip, eqSlot, eqSlotLarge, renderInventory.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent keyed by body and writes core character velocity; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state and character yaw, animation channels and seated locomotion.
scripts/camera.js - core camera rig eye pose and local-player hiding; engine view provides orientation.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js and character-select.js - MMORPG player/character creation state, roster transitions, persistence and preview lifecycle.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - orbit input/pose and creation-phase framing for the mod camera path.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/quest-giver.js - NPC proximity and quest-dialog handoff; quest definitions live in lib/quest-data.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js and lib/ui-*.js - render presentation from player/world state; UI is not gameplay-state owner.
places/main/config.yaml and scripts/terrain-reach.js - terrain shape/material generation inputs; scripts/lib/regions.js owns the named-region lookup data.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → MMORPG menu/player/character-select/main-menu-mgr behaviors → character creation and transition into main.

Character creation confirm in character-select.js → name registry check and character state/persistence; registry failure creates an active character id and continues loading rather than blocking the form.
Creation camera behavior path in mod.json → character-select.js installs camera-creation.js → frames preview; gameplay camera handles orbit outside creation.
world.config.yaml player template → scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js then scripts/player.js; gait samples movement before this tick's movement velocity write.
moveX/moveZ/jump input → scripts/player.js onInput stores room-local intent → update eases velocity and applies place gravity.
world.config.yaml UI renderer → mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js reads local player/world state → lib/ui-* renderers compose HUD, menu, quest and panels; nametag renders separately.

Main-place local player's feetPosition x/z → ui-hud.js inline region tests → name over minimap; scripts/lib/regions.js separately exports the corresponding lookup table, not imported by this HUD path.
Character creation state → ui.js creation renderer and injected name input → setCharName/confirmCharacter actions; NAME_SWEEP removes the persistent DOM name box outside creation.
quest-giver.js proximity/interact → lib/quest-data.js and player activeQuests → showQuestDialog/questDialogData on player → ui.js/lib/ui-quest.js.
lib/ui-door-panel.js reads lib/shop-data.js inventories for the interacting building → shopSelectItem/buyShopItem actions in player.js → gold and inventory state are patched on the player.
lib/item-icons.js iconFor(item id) → lib/ui-inventory.js renders icons for equipment and inventory slots; shop-data.js carries matching art URLs for shop items.

places/main/config.yaml terrain generator → scripts/terrain-reach.js heightAt/materialAt and scatter bindings; authored scene entities use procedural scripts/gen geometry or model assets, while windmill sails animate via scripts/sails-spin.js.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js and windmill*.js - procedural scene geometry reused by instances, varied by kind/shape parameters, dimensions, seed and transforms.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by density, scale and seed; grass-look supplies material separately.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle behaviors registered by mod.json.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - paired gameplay orbit and preview camera modes with creation-phase guards.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - modular panel renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu, quest, inventory, map, character and settings.
scripts/look-default.js and mods/aaa-quality-kit/look-cinema.js - alternative whole-frame post-process looks selected by place atmosphere.
art/tools/build.py and art/townhouse/build.py - asset-building pipelines; tool builder exports each OBJ separately and townhouse builder assembles kit modules plus hand-built structural parts.
migrationNotes: Keep core movement intent and locomotion scratch in room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity and place config owns gravity.
templates/player.js runs humanoid-locomotion before player.js; behavior order determines whether gait samples prior-tick or current movement velocity.
Core scripts/camera.js uses engine look orientation and feetPosition + eyeHeight × effectiveScale.y; MMORPG orbit/creation cameras are a distinct path.
MMORPG camera.js delegates creation framing to camera-creation.js and guards orbit during creation/dialog states; preserve these phase and panel guards.
terrain-reach.js blends the March to a coastline via landFactor and builtin shore(h, 0); sea level is 0, while Sorrowfen terrain is shaped near 0.5 and classified as mud around the FEN center.

Region labels are duplicated: ui-hud.js hardcodes ordered distance/coordinate tests instead of calling scripts/lib/regions.js; item icon lookup is keyed by item id and falls back to the item's existing icon.
